title: Mawaru Penguindrum Anime Inspires Stage Reading Production by Kunihiko Ikuhara
content: Revolutionary Girl Utena director Kunihiko Ikuhara announced on Friday that he is writing and serving as chief director on Ikuni Produce Reading in the dark: Kodomo Broiler Sensō (Ikuni Produce Reading in the dark: Child Broiler War), a brand-new stage reading production inspired by his Penguindrum anime.
author: ANN
